_comment: Prompt prefixes for every showcase's images (tools/art.mjs), from the paper-cutout storybook style guide of the mootion-animator prototype.
ref: Model sheet for a paper-cutout stop-motion storybook animation. Every character and prop listed below, side by side and evenly spaced on plain cream watercolor paper, each one a separate hand-painted watercolor and colored-pencil children's-storybook illustration cut out of paper with a thin clean white die-cut border and a soft drop shadow. Flat straight-on view. Cute round chunky designs, small solid black dot eyes, simple smiles, rosy blush cheeks. Warm muted palette: tomato red, mustard yellow, teal, ultramarine, olive, sage green, blush pink, cream, kraft brown, ink. No text, no labels, no numbers. SHOW:
sprite: Paper-cutout sticker asset for a stop-motion collage animation, on a FULLY TRANSPARENT background. Hand-painted watercolor + colored-pencil children's-storybook illustration, cut out of watercolor paper with a thin clean white paper border following the whole silhouette (die-cut sticker edge). Single isolated subject, centered, whole subject visible with generous margin, flat straight-on view, no cast shadow, no ground, no scenery, no text. Palette: tomato red, mustard yellow, teal, ultramarine, olive, sage green, blush pink, cream. Cute round design, small black dot eyes, rosy blush cheeks. Match the character designs and art style of the attached model sheet exactly. SUBJECT:
bg: Full-frame landscape background for a paper-cutout stop-motion collage animation. Hand-painted watercolor and colored-pencil children's-storybook style on textured paper, warm and muted. No characters, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers. The whole middle of the picture is calm and nearly empty, so cutouts and titles placed on it read clearly; any detail stays near the edges and along the bottom. Flat, straight-on, like a paper diorama photographed head-on. SCENE:
